verdicts_or_reports.expected: Restore the create button when returning to a writable storage folder.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After leaving Images with Home, the create button remains absent in internal storage and nested folders. Rotation restores it; reproduced twice.
steps: Open AndroidQA/Amaze; observe missing create button.
Rotate landscape then portrait; button returns.
Repeat Images > Home; button disappears again.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Keep the properties dialog and its computed folder details open across rotation.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Rotating dismisses the Properties dialog and returns to the file list. Reproduced with Beta and Alpha.
steps: Return portrait and repeat with Alpha: same result.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Remain in Images with the two photos after rotation; preserve selection when active.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Rotation switches Images to internal storage. With photo.jpg selected it also leaves selection mode showing 0. Reproduced again without selection.
steps: In portrait open drawer > Images; keep.jpg and photo.jpg appear.
Select photo.jpg and rotate landscape then portrait; view becomes internal storage with selection count 0.
Exit selection, open drawer > Images again.
Rotate landscape then portrait without selection; again shows /storage/emulated/0.
